theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have lu := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have li := InitStatesLength hi
  have hd := UpdateStatesDefined hu
  have hn := InitStatesNotDefined hi
  have dis : ks.Disjoint ks' := by
    intro k hk hk'
    have h := hd k hk
    simp [hn k hk'] at h
  have hc : updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks vs) ks' vs' =
      updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs := by
    apply updatedStatesComm
    simpa only [List.unzip_zip lu, List.unzip_zip li] using dis
  refine ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl,
    updatedStatesInit li (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' hn hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu, hc]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate lu (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intros Hup Hinit
  exists (updatedStates σ ks' vs')
  have Hk : (isDefined σ' ks) := UpdateStatesDefined Hup
  have Hlen1 := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hlen2 := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  induction Hup generalizing σ''
  case update_none =>
    simp_all
    apply And.intro
    refine updatedStatesInit Hlen1 ?_ ?_
    exact InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
    exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
    simp [InitStatesUpdated Hinit]
    constructor
  case update_some σ x v σ₀ xs vs σ₁ Hup Hups ih =>
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    . apply updatedStatesInit Hlen1
      apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hup
      apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hups
      exact InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
      exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
    . apply UpdateStates.update_some (σ':=updatedStates σ₀ ks' vs')
      . simp [UpdateStateUpdated Hup, updatedStates]
        rw [← updatedStateComm']
        . have Hdef := UpdateStateDefined' Hup
          simp [isDefined, Option.isSome] at Hdef
          split at Hdef <;> norm_cast
          next val heq =>
          apply updatedStateUpdate (v':=val)
          apply InitStatesSomeMonotone heq
          apply updatedStatesInit
          . omega
          . apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hup
            apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hups
            apply InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          . exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
        . rw [List.unzip_zip] <;> norm_cast
          have Hnd := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          simp only [isDefined] at *
          apply Not.intro
          intros Hin
          specialize Hnd _ Hin
          simp_all
      . apply (ih Hinit ?_ ?_).2.2
        . exact UpdateStatesDefined Hups <;> simp_all
        . exact UpdateStatesLength Hups

  intro k hk hk'
  cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  apply exists_eq_left.mpr
  constructor
  apply updatedStatesInit
  exact InitStatesLength hi
  exact UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  exact InitStatesNodup hi
  cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu
  cases InitStatesUpdated hi
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  apply updatedStatesUpdate
  exact UpdateStatesLength hu
  apply updatedStatesDefMonotone
  exact UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, InitStatesLength hi]
  intro k hk hk'
  cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

  intro k hk hk'

  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by

  constructor
  apply updatedStatesInit

  exact InitStatesNodup hi

  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  apply updatedStatesUpdate

  simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, InitStatesLength hi]
  intro k hk hk'
  cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  apply exists_eq_left.2
  constructor
  apply updatedStatesInit
  exact InitStatesLength hi
  exact UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  exact InitStatesNodup hi
  cases UpdateStatesUpdated hu ▸ InitStatesUpdated hi
  unfold updatedStates
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  apply updatedStatesUpdate
  exact UpdateStatesLength hu
  apply updatedStatesDefMonotone
  exact UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, InitStatesLength hi]
  intro k hk hk'
  cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intros Hup Hinit
  exists (updatedStates σ ks' vs')
  have Hk : (isDefined σ' ks) := UpdateStatesDefined Hup
  have Hlen1 := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hlen2 := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  induction Hup generalizing σ''
  case update_none =>
    simp_all
    apply And.intro
    refine updatedStatesInit Hlen1 ?_ ?_
    exact InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
    exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
    simp [InitStatesUpdated Hinit]
    constructor
  case update_some σ x v σ₀ xs vs σ₁ Hup Hups ih =>
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    . apply updatedStatesInit Hlen1
      apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hup
      apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hups
      exact InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
      exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
    . apply UpdateStates.update_some (σ':=updatedStates σ₀ ks' vs')
      . simp [UpdateStateUpdated Hup, updatedStates]
        rw [← updatedStateComm']
        . have Hdef := UpdateStateDefined' Hup
          simp [isDefined, Option.isSome] at Hdef
          split at Hdef <;> norm_cast
          next val heq =>
          apply updatedStateUpdate (v':=val)
          apply InitStatesSomeMonotone heq
          apply updatedStatesInit
          . omega
          . apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hup
            apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hups
            apply InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          . exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
        . rw [List.unzip_zip] <;> norm_cast
          have Hnd := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          simp only [isDefined] at *
          apply Not.intro
          intros Hin
          specialize Hnd _ Hin
          simp_all
      . apply (ih Hinit ?_ ?_).2.2
        . exact UpdateStatesDefined Hups <;> simp_all
        . exact UpdateStatesLength Hups
